Sustainability

ICL’s Sustainability Vision for 2030

We are fully committed to upholding the highest standards of environmental responsibility, with sustainability as our guiding compass. This commitment drives us to continuously develop innovative solutions for the most pressing challenges facing our world.

Impact Focus Areas

Food Security &
Innovative Safe Progress

ICL is at the forefront of the global fight against hunger, playing a critical role in enhancing food security through its innovative agricultural solutions.  By focusing on these critical areas we continue on our quest to develop life-saving and sustainable energy storage systems (ESS) which improve people’s lives.

Learn More

Business Segments

ICL leverages its technological innovation to drive growth across multiple market segments.

Our operations are organized into four key business segments: Growing Solutions, Industrial Products, Phosphate Solutions and Potash.

Our Partnerships

Our Community

We are deeply committed to creating networks of social good in the communities we serve

By investing in social entrepreneurs and championing social innovation, we use our resources and expertise to build lasting partnerships that bring real, meaningful change. We believe in the power of our people, encouraging every employee to volunteer and make a positive impact in their local communities. Together, we strive to create a better, brighter future for all.
